method: Labeled by hand from the three local videos: 1 fps contact sheets of every video, score-bug crops at 1 fps to time each basket by the score change and the shot-clock reset, and full-resolution crops at 0.04-0.5 s steps to read jersey numbers and tell dunks from layups. YouTube's automatic captions were used only as a search aid (spoken mentions, play locations). Neither system's output was read before these labels were written. Each event lists the live range first, then every replay of the same moment. Times are m:ss.s from the start of the local file. 'ambiguous' holds moments the labels could not settle; a clip there is neither credited nor penalized.
